cat > autoplay.py <<'PY'
import arena, subprocess, sys, time
n=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 15
secs=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 60
for i in range(n):
 b=arena.load_board()
 if arena.result(b):
  arena.show(b); break
 p=subprocess.run(['./think',b.fen(),str(secs)],text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
 print('\nMOVE',b.fullmove_number, 'FEN',b.fen(),flush=True)
 print('\n'.join(p.stdout.splitlines()[-3:]),flush=True)
 move=p.stdout.split('best ')[-1].split()[0]
 if move not in [m.uci() for m in b.legal_moves]:
  print('ILLEGAL',move,flush=True);break
 arena.cmd_move(move)
 sys.stdout.flush()
PY
nohup python3 -u autoplay.py 15 90 > auto.log 2>&1 & echo $!
